segments.title: Cold Open & Studio Setup

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchored a sprawling Wednesday broadcast covering Pete Hegseth's Senate hearing, a SCOTUS redistricting ruling, and a Winnipeg sinkhole rescue before triggering Chet Guy the Science Eyes on BCI headphones and false vacuum decay. A reskinned AI Rooney processed viewer complaints until explicit fetish loops forced a shutdown, then Munch and Crum debated misogyny and Kendall's arbitration authority — Pepito ruling Crum the loser. The episode closed with a town hall featuring Gianna Wet Mitchell and Lil Tommy Big Law, Brandon's keyboard-only Wild Guns run, and Case shopping colonial wigs before raiding a Magic: The Gathering stream.
